longDescription: Criminal intelligence is a critical part of police operations. Information, on its own, is not intelligence. However, when the intelligence process is properly applied, criminal intelligence allows law enforcement to effectively interpret the criminal environment and forecast future actions or trends. Introduction to Criminal Intelligence focuses on each element of the intelligence process and how those elements contribute to the development of criminal intelligence.
